title: ProperNames
description: Own names of the inhabitants (Marcel W1698): the core picks one per inhabitant, deterministically by the world seed, distinct while the lists allow. An inhabitant gets a name of its sex (female, male) or one that fits anybody (names); without the lists of a sex it picks from all names (A1557, D809 M2). Placeholder lists; where the names come from is decided later. Each name is a ProperName (one word in Latin letters, the same in DE and EN) and appears in only one of the lists.

names.description: Names that fit an inhabitant of either sex; at least one, so that a sex without a list of its own still finds a name that is not only for the other sex.

female.description: Names only for female inhabitants (omitted = none of its own).

male.description: Names only for male inhabitants (omitted = none of its own).
